Looking at the table:

- Euro impact in 2012: 27.1

Percentage change formula: ((new value - old value) / old value) × 100%

Percentage change = ((27.1 - 26.4) / 26.4) × 100%
= (0.7 / 26.4) × 100%
= 0.026515... × 100%
≈ 2.65%
